title: Push notifications not delivered on Android 15
text:
## Problem

Push notifications never arrive on phones running **Android 15**. iOS and Android 14 and older work correctly.

This affects 5 of the 12 Westbrook beta testers Tomas Rivera interviewed. They miss the "Your study group meets in 30 minutes" reminder, which is our most important notification.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Install the beta build on a phone with Android 15
2. Join a study group with a session in the next hour
3. Wait for the 30-minute reminder - it never shows up

## Likely cause

Android 15 requires the app to ask for the notification permission at runtime. Our onboarding never asks for it, so the system blocks all notifications.

## Fix

Ask for the notification permission on the last onboarding screen. Estimated 2 to 3 days.

Reported by Sam Okafor. On the risk list for the Nov 2 launch.
